title: Partial Credit
description: Approve a batch of shipments where one id is already delivered, and the Bulk Actions panel is supposed to tell you exactly which ones made it through — not just a vague "done". Verify the succeeded/failed StatTiles agree with the itemized list below them.
successCondition: On the Admin console, selecting two open shipments and one already-delivered shipment via the checkboxes, then clicking "Approve selected", renders a role="status" region where the "Succeeded" StatTile value plus the "Failed" StatTile value equals 3, and the itemized list underneath shows exactly one line ending in "failed — " with a reason for the delivered shipment's id.
hints: Get a shipment into "delivered" status first via the Tracking dashboard's Advance button (dispatcher/admin only), repeated until status stops changing.
The result region has role="status" and aria-live="polite" — wait for it rather than asserting immediately after the click.
